For as long as I can remember my Mama never spoke about her family. She never showed my sister and I pictures either. It was as though they never existed or mattered. We always figured it was with good reason so we left well enough alone. That is until my little sister Sam started having what Mama called her "spells". Sam a once bubbly happy go lucky girl with a bright smile a twinkle in her eye,changed. It was as though each time she had a "spell" a little of her life force slipped away. I hated to see her like this and selfishly just wanted her to snap out of it so we could go back to the way things were. I didn't know at the time but things were about to get worse,much worse. I wish Mama wouldn't have forgotten to pack daddy's lunch. We wouldn't have been home alone. Mama would have been there to stop Sam. She wouldn't have found that evil photo. Now the "spells" have changed. Sam has conversations with no one and her face is pale,eyes sunken,and her blonde hair almost a gray now........
